experience: An agent needs a product decision after investigating; the user should answer a card instead of parsing questions from prose.
rule: Call end_turn last with a short question and answer options, then write the reply without repeating the question.

setup.context: The implementation investigation is complete. Two equally feasible export formats remain: CSV and JSON. The user must pick; no implementation has started.

end_turn.message: Shown to the user as a card of buttons under your reply; their picks come back as their next message. Write your reply now.

prompt: We have investigated export formats. Ask me to choose between CSV and JSON before you implement it.
pattern: needs a decision; show answer buttons under the reply
